source_observation: ResourcePaths::from_map accepts a HashMap of source-to-target mappings and can yield more than one distinct source with the same target path.
tauri-build copy_resources joins each yielded target under the output directory and copies sequentially without checking for duplicate targets.
The file-copy helper creates/truncates the target, so source reading predicts that a later colliding source can overwrite an earlier one.
Because the configured mapping is stored in a HashMap, there is no stable user-defined source ordering that could make an overwrite winner intentional.
repair_sketch: If the focused regression reproduces the collision, resolve all sources and target paths first, reject a target mapped from multiple distinct canonical sources, then perform copies only after the collision check succeeds.
execution_status: No retained target execution receipt exists. Treat this as a source-supported data-integrity suspicion with a runnable regression, not a reproduced bug or validated candidate.
limitations: Focused exact-path regression has not been retained as target-executed.
Case-insensitive aliases, Unicode-normalization aliases, and final installer output remain untested.
A duplicate mapping that resolves to the same canonical source may be harmless and should not be rejected by a repair.
